description.value: Glacier Lodge is a vacation rental condo property in Whistler managed through WhistlerAccommodation.com (Blackcomb Peaks), which specializes in ski-in/ski-out rentals on Blackcomb Mountain. The three-storey building offers self-contained units typical of Whistler's condo-hotel market, with at least one unit (212) listed as an active rental. Its location near Chateau Boulevard places it within easy reach of Whistler Village and the surrounding trail network.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record lists Glacier Lodge at 4573 Chateau Boulevard with phone +1-604-905-4607 and website theglacierlodge.com. The website resolves to WhistlerAccommodation.com (operated by Blackcomb Peaks), a vacation rental management company; Glacier Lodge appears in their property portfolio as 'Glacier Lodge 212', confirming the property exists and is actively rented. No amenity details specific to Glacier Lodge are present on this aggregator page, and the phone/address shown belong to the management company rather than the property itself.
concerns: Website theglacierlodge.com resolves to WhistlerAccommodation.com (Blackcomb Peaks), a third-party rental management company — no dedicated Glacier Lodge website exists.
Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-604-905-4607 but the website shows the management company number 1-866-590-1613.
Address on website (4800 Spearhead Dr) is the management company's office address, not the property address; OSM address 4573 Chateau Boulevard could not be independently confirmed from the website.
Property appears to operate as a vacation rental condo (individual units listed, e.g. Glacier Lodge 212) rather than a traditional staffed hotel, despite the tourism=hotel OSM tag.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Glacier Lodge is a real, active vacation rental property in Whistler confirmed by its listing on the management company's platform; it is publicly bookable accommodation useful to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: All amenity fields are null due to the website providing no property-specific detail — only a unit listing on an aggregator page. Direct contact with the management company (Blackcomb Peaks / WhistlerAccommodation.com) would be needed to verify cyclist amenities.
